sell.metaTitle: Sell on Kaaravan — Partner with Pakistan's Artisan Marketplace
sell.metaDesc: Join Kaaravan as a verified merchant or artisan guild. Fair commissions, transparent logistics, and nationwide buyers.
sell.heroTitle: Bring Your Handcrafted Heritage to the Kaaravan
sell.heroSubtitle: The modern multi-vendor marketplace designed specifically for Pakistani artisans, heritage workshops, and independent merchants. We handle shipping pickups, secure payments, and buyer trust so you can focus on making timeless craft.
sell.feature1Desc: No hidden deductions or predatory fees. Fixed commission rates (5–8%) with a permanent, tamper-proof record of every transaction.
sell.feature2Desc: Integrated with major Pakistani logistics couriers. Couriers collect boxed shipments directly from your workshop in any city.
sell.feature3Desc: Automated IVR and WhatsApp verification before order dispatch to protect merchants from high return-to-origin (RTO) courier costs.
sell.cohortTitle: Actively onboarding guild masters across Pakistan
sell.cohortDesc: Right now, our team is curating our founding merchant cohort from Multan Kashikari, Namak Mandi leather artisans, Chiniot woodworkers, and Hunza organic cooperatives. Self-serve vendor registration and inventory management are coming soon.
sell.bullet1: Full autonomy over your own storefront and inventory
sell.bullet2: Direct IBFT bank payouts into verified Pakistani business accounts
sell.bullet3: Urdu and English multilingual listing editor
